name: numbers-report
goal: Create and verify a small numbers report

specification.goal: Create and verify a small numbers report

functional_requirements.description: The report states the count and sum of the supplied numbers.

nfrs.description: The report has an inspectable verification record.

done_when: numbers.csv contains the three source values
contract.shared_reason: The source dataset is the prerequisite for the one report deliverable.

argv: import json; from pathlib import Path; numbers=[int(x) for x in Path('numbers.csv').read_text().splitlines()]; Path('report.json').write_text(json.dumps({'count':len(numbers),'sum':sum(numbers)}))

ready_when: the accepted source dataset is available
done_when: report.json states the count and sum

argv: import json; from pathlib import Path; report=json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text()); assert report == {'count':3,'sum':10}; Path('verification.txt').write_text('PASS: 3 numbers total 10\n')

done_when: verification.txt records the passing count-and-sum check
contract.shared_reason: This checks both the report requirement and its durable evidence.
